_note: 캐릭터 buffer 13프레임 = 6셀 시트 A(idle·walk2·attack2·special) + B(dash4·hurt·death) + 단독 C(invuln). 프레임 이름은 SpriteBank.JOB_FRAMES 규격 그대로 — 어긋나면 조용히 누락된다.

rulesets.c6: Match the REFERENCE IMAGE EXACTLY: the SAME bard — a wide green witch hat with a gold band, dark-green coat with gold trim, holding a wooden lute across the chest. Reproduce the reference's hand-drawn pixel-art style precisely: same dot size, thin dark outlines, soft cel shading, same body proportions (stocky heroic chibi), same palette. THREE-QUARTER FRONT view at eye level, the FULL BODY standing, both feet visible on the ground. Not photorealistic, not 3D-rendered, no smooth gradients. LAYOUT: a 3-column by 2-row grid of 6 cells with clear empty pure-magenta gaps between the cells. The SAME knight, SAME scale, SAME camera angle in every cell, feet resting on a common baseline. The six poses MUST differ dramatically so motion is obvious when flipped through. Follow each cell's description literally. No grid lines, no labels, no text. COLOR: full color, matching the reference palette. Background: flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere, no ground, no shadow, no scenery.
